title: Popsy Pop
writer: Henri Charrière, Jean Herman, J.B. Beellsolell
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Stanley Baker, Henri Charrière
plot: Popsy double-crosses her older partner Silva. Silva has arranged to divert diamonds from a large corporate-run diamond mine in the South American jungle, and Popsy does her "pop" wrong as they are both pursued by police.
